items.title: Unauthenticated Customer Account Takeover / Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows unauthenticated remote attackers to switch customer sessions, hijack accounts, and access private data due to an incorrect authorization flaw. Exploitation attempts were detected shortly after disclosure.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
items.summary: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass in B2B)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce B2B that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. It requires neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Security-Feature Bypass)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could enable a security-feature bypass. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization (Privilege Escalation)
items.summary: An incorrect-authorization vulnerability that could result in privilege escalation. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer extension for Magento and Adobe Commerce, allowing remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Adobe Commerce Auth Bypass Vulnerability
items.summary: An incorrect authorization flaw in Adobe Commerce that enables remote, unauthenticated attackers to bypass security measures and gain unauthorized write access without user interaction.

items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Magento's REST API
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by disguising code as an image (polyglot). Fixed in Magento 2.4.9.
